description: This file defines the registration route component and related server logic for a web app, including loader and action functions for authentication redirection and user session management, as well as a React component rendering a registration form.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Redirects to /app if user is already authenticated; otherwise, renders an empty JSON response.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Processes form data to create a session for new user registration, validating input and redirecting upon success.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: React component rendering registration form UI.
